name: Build orchestrator
author: Brett
description: Breaks every build into small steps (30 min or less), each pinned to Fable or Opus. Consecutive same-model steps form a phase; a phase that switches model waits for Brett's approval. Token rules on every build: one session, no sub-agents unless a step allows it, briefs carry only the current phase. Page = tab group (Builds, Approvals, Rules); the Builds tab looks and behaves like Pending builds, with more options (per-step model, phases, approve switch, next-phase brief, hide, archive, import from Pending, move/edit/remove steps). Tracker is a repo file, _claude/builds/orchestrator.json, so any session or account continues the build (orchestrator.mjs next | brief | act).
